# Slimzol

> Product information and ordering for Slimzol, a liquid weight loss support dietary supplement sold in a 1 Fl Oz (30 mL) dropper bottle with 30 servings. Published for readers in the United States at https://slimzol-org.vercel.app/. Orders complete on the seller's own checkout. Last reviewed 13 November 2026.

Each 1 mL dropperful of Slimzol supplies 7 mcg of chromium as chromium picolinate, which is 20% of the Daily Value, plus a 15.47 mg proprietary blend of 22 botanical extracts, amino acids and related compounds. Suggested use is to shake well, take one dropperful daily, place it in the mouth and swallow. One bottle is a 30-day supply. Made in the USA with globally sourced ingredients. Prices are $79, $69 and $49 per bottle for the two, three and six-bottle packs, with a 60-day money-back guarantee on every size. For adults 18 and over.

- [FDA: dietary supplements](https://www.fda.gov/food/dietary-supplements): the framework under which supplements are regulated as food rather than as drugs.
